title: Diver and Orca in Fjord
description: A lone rower sits in a small wooden boat on a calm mountain lake under an aurora-filled sky with multiple glowing celestial bodies. Below the water's surface, a diver in a wetsuit freefalls toward the depths while a large orca swims beside her, both illuminated by dramatic light rays.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene of a lone figure rowing a small wooden boat on a perfectly still mountain lake. The sky features a vibrant green aurora borealis, a bright sun, and three glowing celestial orbs. Below the waterline, a female diver in a full black wetsuit is suspended mid-descent with arms outstretched, swimming beside a large realistic orca. Dramatic god rays pierce the deep blue water. Highly detailed digital painting with cinematic lighting and reflections.
